Resolves #20330

A pull request now runs only the e2e specs its change can reach.
- **The map.** `buildScripts/util/e2eSpecReach.mjs` maps each spec to the app it navigates, that app's static closure (every literal `.mjs` path a module names), and the spec's own helpers.
- **The selection.** `selectSpecs` in `e2eCiSelection.mjs` picks the reached specs and the changed specs. The specs the map cannot place and `BRAIN_SMOKE` run with every selection. It runs the full population for:
  - a foundation path;
  - a file that loads modules by name or by computed path;
  - a module no static edge names, since a computed import can still load it;
  - a file the map cannot place, or that the tree no longer holds;
  - unimported e2e support;
  - a change whose files are all e2e specs.
- **The wiring.** With `select_e2e`, the classifier checks out a pull request's merge tree and runs `--select` over the files the boundary admitted. Each tier then gets its files and a matrix sized to them: proportional, at least one shard, never more shards than files. A tier with no selected spec starts no job.
- **Pushes.** A `dev` push never selects, so every tier it admits runs in full.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms on the real tree, plus this PR's own CI running the new classifier steps on a full selection) → L3 required (AC-7's job summary and AC-9's sized matrix show only on a selective pull request, and this one touches workflow files, so it always selects in full). Residual: AC-7, AC-9, Residual-Owner: #20328.

## Deltas from ticket

- **Not shipped: narrowing by named classes.** Fix step 1's "narrowed by the classes and views the spec itself names" isn't in this PR. No receipt measured it, and narrowing can only add misses. The map is the measured model: app closure plus the spec's own helpers.
- **Wider than the measured model.** The changes are listed in receipts v4 and v5: more edge shapes, interpolated app paths, the docs entry and app-fetched files. Deleted files run full, and so do modules no static edge names (Emmy's RA-1). Every change widens the selection. Recall went from 7 misses to 3, at the cost of about 3 points of saving.
- **Brain tier and constants.** The Brain-gated tier gains a `selected` tier, and its receipt explains only the declarations touching the selected files. `FULL_SHARDS` declares both full matrices.
- **Merged with #20404 and #20450.** #20404 moved single-app Neural Link specs into the engine tier, which now runs 8 shards; `FULL_SHARDS.engine` and the fallback the parity arm reads carry 8. #20450 removed the Brain capability gating, so the `selected` Brain tier filters by the selection alone. That tier retires with the rest of the Brain-gated tier in #20451.

## Test Evidence

- **Replay discrimination.** Run against the previous selector in a base worktree at `6499e01296`, the replay arm fails and names `42042806935` and `42058376779`: the rows that only the RA-1 rule runs in full. On the merged tree, those two are recorded misses. `useMemo` now has static importers, so RA-1 no longer runs that change in full, and the map places `DockCrossWindowWitnessNL` with a reach that contains no `src/functional` module. Both reds were a harness failure (`Target worker 'cw-win-a' does not exist`), not the change.
- **Parser comparison.** On the fixture's module text, the dry-run regex finds 1 of the 4 edges and the shipped one finds all 4.
- **Local buildScripts unit specs.** Base `f82061f2c9` and head fail the same 16 tests: `esmWorkspaceBuild` and `templateBuildProcessor`, because this checkout's shared `node_modules` lacks `postcss-scss`. Head passes 940. Before I updated them, my change had broken 3 `WorkflowScopeClassifier` contract pins.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] The first leaf-only pull request after merge runs a sized matrix. Both tiers' summaries list the selection with a reason per spec, and a tier with nothing selected reports skipped with the selection's reason.
- [ ] The next `dev` push runs both tiers in full.
